doc.title: Will Shade and Dewey Corley Interview, 1960-05-25

title: Corley's playing partners and Little Walter
summary: Corley lists those he played with, including Charlie Pierce, Red Robey, Shaky Head Walter, and Little Walter, whom he says was taught in Memphis.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: Okay, well, let's get back to doing now. Who all did you play with?

Well, I played with Charlie Pierce. He played violin. Red Robey. Red Robey played guitar. And the little boy we used to have here, I mean, stuff. He played guitar. All those fellas. And Shaky Head Walter. He played harmonica. Little Walter. Played with Muddy Walter now. We teached him around here. He played his harmonica.
Little Walter. Right from Memphis. Right from under the jug band. That's us in place. All of them. They ain't got nothing on us.
Where's Muddy Walter from? He's from down in Mississippi, I believe.
Did he play around here any?
He never played around here any.
